title: GOV-0031: source-supports-claim is not machine-checkable — a VERIFIED claim can cite a resolving source whose content does not entail it (RSR-I06 candidate)
problem:
## Observed
`fact-checking` (WP-0047) makes claim status↔evidence consistency deterministic (control 21), but one part of its `CITATION ≠ SUPPORT` invariant is **not machine-checkable with the current contract**. A claim can be `VERIFIED` citing a resolving, `PRIMARY`, digest-bound source whose **content does not actually entail the claim** — and the gate accepts it, because a source record carries only `id`, `uri`, `source_type`, `retrieved_at`, `digest`, `note`. There is no content excerpt, locator, or entailment field for the gate to compare the claim against.

Measured: source item properties = `['digest','id','note','retrieved_at','source_type','uri']` — no content/entailment locator. So `SOURCE_EXISTS ≠ SOURCE_SUPPORTS_CLAIM` cannot be enforced deterministically today.

## Expected
Decide, before `badf-research` reaches `ACTIVE`, whether to make semantic support machine-checkable — the candidate invariant:

```
RSR-I06 (candidate): a source may support a claim only if the cited evidence
semantically entails or directly substantiates it. SOURCE_EXISTS != SOURCE_SUPPORTS_CLAIM.
```

Possible directions (design decision, not yet chosen):
- add an **evidence locator** to the claim↔source binding (a quoted excerpt + a byte/line/anchor range within the digest-bound source) that a human or a later `deep-research` receipt fills, so the gate can at least require a locator for a `VERIFIED`/`PRIMARY` binding (presence-of-locator is deterministic; semantic entailment is not);
- or keep semantic support as a **declared non-coverage** the `fact-checking` skill must state (control 9/non-coverage), never asserted as machine-verified.

## Unknowns
Whether BADF wants a locator field at all (schema growth vs. leanness), and whether entailment stays a human/AI judgment recorded as non-coverage rather than a gate control. This issue records the gap; the resolution is a separate governed WP.

discovered-by: BADF-WP-0047 (fact-checking, failing-first) · status: DISCOVERED
note: Resolves GOV-0031 by adopting RSR-I06 (SOURCE_EXISTS != SOURCE_SUPPORTS_CLAIM) as a separation-of-responsibility invariant, plus a machine-enforceable support-assessment receipt (locator) and control 27 (semantic-support coverage honesty). Semantic entailment stays evidence-assessment, never a deterministic policy assertion; authority impact NONE. Operator directive 2026-08-29. Worked as BADF-WP-0061.
